import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int m = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        String[] aLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        long[] a = new long[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = Long.parseLong(aLine[i]);
        }

        int mid = n / 2;

        List<Long> firstHalf = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Long> secondHalf = new ArrayList<>();

        generateFirst(0, 0, a, m, mid, firstHalf);
        generateSecond(mid, 0, a, m, n, secondHalf);

        Set<Long> firstSet = new HashSet<>(firstHalf);
        List<Long> uniqueFirst = new ArrayList<>(firstSet);
        Collections.sort(uniqueFirst);

        long bestSum = 0;

        for (Long val : secondHalf) {
            long target = m - val;
            int idx = Collections.binarySearch(uniqueFirst, target);
            if (idx < 0) {
                idx = -idx - 1;
            }
            if (idx > 0) {
                long candidate = uniqueFirst.get(idx - 1) + val;
                if (candidate > bestSum) {
                    bestSum = candidate;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(bestSum);
    }

    private static void generateFirst(int i, long total, long[] a, int m, int mid, List<Long> firstHalf) {
        if (i == mid) {
            firstHalf.add(total);
        } else {
            generateFirst(i + 1, (total + a[i]) % m, a, m, mid, firstHalf);
            generateFirst(i + 1, total, a, m, mid, firstHalf);
        }
    }

    private static void generateSecond(int i, long total, long[] a, int m, int n, List<Long> secondHalf) {
        if (i == n) {
            secondHalf.add(total);
        } else {
            generateSecond(i + 1, (total + a[i]) % m, a, m, n, secondHalf);
            generateSecond(i + 1, total, a, m, n, secondHalf);
        }
    }
}
